## FORMAT with ARRAY values
# Expected values: BigQuery's FORMAT documentation, which formats an ARRAY for %t and %T as
# [value, value, ...] with each value formatted by the same specifier, and GoogleSQL compliance
# functions_testlib_format.cc, functions_testlib_format_nulls.cc and
# functions_testlib_format_floating_point.cc, which agree with it.
# UNNEST prevents constant folding by the analyzer.

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([0, 1] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[0, 1]"

SELECT FORMAT('%T', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([0, 1] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[0, 1]"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', [0, 1])
=> "[0, 1]"

SELECT FORMAT('%t|%T', s.a, s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INT64>) AS a)]) AS s
=> "NULL|NULL"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([5, NULL, -6] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[5, NULL, -6]"

SELECT FORMAT('%T', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([5, NULL, -6] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[5, NULL, -6]"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([5.0, NULL, -6.0] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[5.0, NULL, -6.0]"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([-4, CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[-4.0, inf]"

SELECT FORMAT('%T', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([-4, CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64)] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[-4.0, CAST(\"-inf\" AS FLOAT64)]"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([DATETIME '1970-01-01 00:00:00', DATETIME '2016-04-26 15:23:27.123456'] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[1970-01-01 00:00:00, 2016-04-26 15:23:27.123456]"

SELECT FORMAT('%T', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([DATETIME '1970-01-01 00:00:00', DATETIME '2016-04-26 15:23:27.123456'] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[DATETIME \"1970-01-01 00:00:00\", DATETIME \"2016-04-26 15:23:27.123456\"]"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([TIME '00:00:00', TIME '15:23:27.123456'] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[00:00:00, 15:23:27.123456]"

SELECT FORMAT('%T', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([TIME '00:00:00', TIME '15:23:27.123456'] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[TIME \"00:00:00\", TIME \"15:23:27.123456\"]"

SELECT FORMAT('%s', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([0, 1] AS a)]) AS s
=> error:

SELECT FORMAT('%d', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([0, 1] AS a)]) AS s
=> error:

# Confirmed against BigQuery.
SELECT FORMAT('%t', [RANGE<DATE> '[2020-01-01, 2020-02-01)'])
=> "[[2020-01-01, 2020-02-01)]"

SELECT FORMAT('%t|%T', s.a, s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(ARRAY<INT64>[] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[]|[]"

SELECT FORMAT('%t|%T', s.a, s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([JSON '{"a": 1}', NULL] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[{\"a\":1}, NULL]|[JSON '{\"a\":1}', NULL]"

SELECT FORMAT('%t|%T', s.a, s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([RANGE(DATE '2024-01-01', NULL)] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[[2024-01-01, NULL)]|[RANGE<DATE> \"[2024-01-01, UNBOUNDED)\"]"

# Confirmed against BigQuery: %t ends at the NUL of a STRING element.
SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([CONCAT('a', CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING([0]), 'b')] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[a"

# Confirmed against BigQuery: the width pads the text that ends at the NUL.
SELECT FORMAT('[%5t]', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([STRUCT(CONCAT('a', CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING([0]), 'b') AS x)] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[  [(a]"
